what: GitHub CLI authenticated with repo and workflow scopes
how: gh auth login; gh auth refresh -h github.com -s workflow

what: Qloo hackathon API key available to the project (never printed)
how: copy the key into .env as QLOO_API_KEY (the key you received by email; keep ~/.config/qloo/key as a private backup)

what: Hosting account (Vercel) signed in, project created for Headliner
how: vercel.com sign-up with GitHub; install the Vercel CLI (npm i -g vercel) and run vercel login; create the project from the GitHub repo

what: Neon Postgres database and connection string
how: neon.tech sign-up; create project headliner; copy the pooled connection string into .env as DATABASE_URL and into the Vercel project's environment

what: OpenAI API key with a project budget limit of 5 USD
how: platform.openai.com -> Settings -> Billing / Limits: set the monthly budget limit to 5 USD; then API keys -> create a project key; copy into .env as OPENAI_API_KEY (production copy: see P-13). The model (LLM_MODEL) is chosen by the owner against OpenAI's current pricing page before M3-01

what: Joined the Qloo Discord and posted the organiser questions
how: discord.gg/rF9PKsD5Q7 -> #api-help; post the text drafted by M0-04

what: Node.js 24 or newer and npm 11 or newer
how: install Node 24 LTS (nodejs.org or nvm install 24); npm ships with it

what: gitleaks CLI installed locally (gate commands run it; CI uses the action)
how: sudo apt install gitleaks, or download a release binary from github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases into ~/.local/bin

what: Playwright Chromium and its system libraries
how: after M0-01 installs dependencies: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium (the --with-deps step needs sudo)

what: Vercel project environment holds QLOO_API_KEY, DATABASE_URL and BUDGET_SALT for production
how: Vercel dashboard -> project headliner -> Settings -> Environment Variables -> add QLOO_API_KEY, DATABASE_URL and BUDGET_SALT (a long random string you generate) for Production; DEMO_MODE=fixtures stays on Preview. Or: vercel env add <NAME> production
verify: vercel env ls production 2>/dev/null | grep -q QLOO_API_KEY && vercel env ls production 2>/dev/null | grep -q DATABASE_URL && vercel env ls production 2>/dev/null | grep -q BUDGET_SALT

how: Vercel dashboard -> project headliner -> Settings -> Environment Variables -> add OPENAI_API_KEY for Production (same key as P-05, which has the 5 USD cap). Or: vercel env add OPENAI_API_KEY production
verify: vercel env ls production 2>/dev/null | grep -q OPENAI_API_KEY

what: Throwaway Neon branch for the budget tests (TEST_DATABASE_URL)
how: Neon console -> project headliner -> Branches -> Create branch (name test) -> Connection details -> copy the pooled string into .env as TEST_DATABASE_URL

what: External uptime monitor on the demo URL with an email alert
how: uptimerobot.com (or betterstack.com) free sign-up -> Add monitor -> HTTP(s) -> URL <demo URL>/api/health -> alert contact: your email. Record only the monitor name in docs/runbook.md
lands_in: monitor account (no secret in the repo)

what: Owner approves making the repo public (recorded on the M4-SUBMIT issue)
how: comment approval on the M4-SUBMIT issue after M4-GATE passes

what: Screen recorder and a place to host the optional demo video
how: any recorder (OBS, or the OS one); upload to YouTube as unlisted; link goes on the M4-02 issue only. Skip if no video

what: Standing approvals decided by the owner (merge green PRs, Vercel deploys, live Qloo calls within quota, npm installs from lockfile)
how: answer the standing-approvals question on the M0-00 issue
